shared_elements: repeated small linear signs in rows
justification: A is a single large three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a massive head and torso bearing low-relief motifs including a prominent disc on the back and curved symmetrical designs, whereas B is a flat panel scattered with small schematic outline images dominated by long crewed boats with rows of stroke-like crew marks, plus tiny human figures and animals. The only overlap is the generic presence of a disc-like circle and schematic humanoid forms; the organising principle (one monumental body-shaped image versus dispersed narrative-style small signs, with the boat motif entirely absent in A) is wholly different.
